premises.text: Field professionals do site investigation with pen, paper, and markers, producing messy sketches that must be recreated again on desktop CAD—wasted duplicated effort
premises.evidence_span: he's doing the same thing two or even three times, once or twice on paper and again on the computer

premises.text: ArcSight converts freehand iPad sketches into precise geometry in real time with dimensions, recognizing combinations of lines and arcs and predicting tangency
premises.evidence_span: ArcSight converts his freehand input into perfect, precise geometry

premises.text: Users can load blueprints, sketch/measure distances and angles on them, and place photos at locations with sketch/measure on photos so field data stays organized in one exportable digital file
premises.evidence_span: all the data is well organized, so he doesn't need to remember where the photos were taken anymore

premises.text: ArcSight Basic launches free on the App Store; Pro will add advanced features, cloud service, and coworker collaboration/sharing
premises.evidence_span: we are launching ArcSight Basic at App Store. It will be a totally free download
